=== ADULT MODE / PIN VALIDATION ===
info:
PIN validation flow:
1. Frontend publishes pin to dashboard/panels/<id>/pin/validate
2. Node-RED validates against config
3. On success: sets mode to adult, publishes session expiry
4. On failure: publishes pin/result with error
5. Timer runs to auto-expire adult session

=== WAKE ON MOTION ===
info:
Handles wake_on_motion toggle and actual motion events.
Motion events come from Zigbee2MQTT via the motion tab.

name: Handle wake_on_motion/set
func:
// Payload: 'true' | 'false' | true | false
const state = flow.get('panel_kitchen') || {}
const enabled = msg.payload === true || msg.payload === 'true' || msg.payload === 'on'
state.wake_on_motion = enabled
flow.set('panel_kitchen', state)

msg.topic = 'dashboard/panels/kitchen/wake_on_motion/state'
msg.payload = enabled ? 'on' : 'off'
return msg

name: === CAMERA OVERRIDE ===
info:
Fullscreen camera takeover flow:
1. override/camera/set with { camera_id, camera_url, camera_name, duration_seconds }
2. Sets active_override in state, publishes override/state
3. Timer auto-restores previous view after duration
4. override/restore cancels immediately

name: Build volume request
func:
// delta is relative volume change e.g. +5 or -5
const room = env.get('SONOS_ROOM') || 'Küche'
const sonosApiUrl = env.get('SONOS_API_URL') || 'http://localhost:5005'
const delta = msg.payload.delta || 0
const sign = delta >= 0 ? '%2B' : ''
msg.method = 'GET'
msg.url = `${sonosApiUrl}/${encodeURIComponent(room)}/volume/${sign}${delta}`
return msg
